title: The Weeds Among the Wheat
reflectionText: The servants wanted to pull the weeds out at once, but the owner said no — not yet, or the wheat would come up with them. Both would grow together until the harvest. Jesus did not soften what the harvest means: a furnace, and weeping, and the righteous shining like the sun. What do you do with a field where good and evil are still growing side by side?
